dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: Why that of the high-altitude aqueducts, of course! These will become key arteries for Remuria, allowing purveyors, pedestrians, and pilgrims alike to pass.

dialogues.speaker: Mécantre
dialogues.text: But there are still a great many issues to solve. First, materials! Then, the bridge support schematics...
